title: Design System: Adobe (as captured from adobe.com)

fonts.licence: proprietary (Adobe Fonts kit pps7abe, bound to adobe.com); needs an Adobe Fonts web project for the target domain

openSubstitute.suggestion: Source Sans 3 (Adobe Originals, SIL OFL) for body; heaviest weight (900) for display

motion.registerRationale: modular product/catalogue site with scroll-driven card choreography (bento stacks, staggered reveals); measured on adobe.com
motion.media: autoplay muted loop video with visible pause button

layout.heroPattern: split: copy left (~450px), media bleeds off right edge; content sheet with rounded top rises over hero
layout.bands: light (#fff/#f8f8f8/#f3f3f3) and dark (#000/#131313) full-bleed bands alternate
layout.sectionIntro: centred eyebrow (16/700) + H2 + lede above grids

dos: Short declarative headlines with full stops
donts: No Adobe logo, product names or product colours out of context

components.name: Media Card
components.description: Rounded media card with caption; rises in on scroll.
components.html:
Create complex composites.

Combine images with unlimited layers.
components.css: .ds-card{width:300px;font:400 16px/24px 'Adobe Clean',adobe-clean,'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif;color:#000}.ds-card-media{aspect-ratio:4/3;border-radius:16px;background:#e1e1e1}.ds-card h3{margin:16px 0 8px;font:900 24px/24px 'Adobe Clean Display','Adobe Clean',adobe-clean,'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.96px}.ds-card p{margin:0;color:#000000a3}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){@supports (animation-timeline:view()){.ds-card{animation:ds-rise linear both;animation-timeline:view(40% 10%);animation-range:entry}}}@keyframes ds-rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

components.name: Merch Card
components.html:

components.css: .ds-merch{width:276px;padding:24px;border-radius:8px;background:#eaeaea;font:400 14px/21px 'Adobe Clean',adobe-clean,'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif;color:#2c2c2c}.ds-merch h3{margin:4px 0 8px;font:800 24px/30px 'Adobe Clean',adobe-clean,'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif}.ds-eyebrow{margin:0;font:700 12px/16px 'Adobe Clean',adobe-clean,'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif}

components.name: Section Intro
components.html:
Core capabilities

Transform images with the app that sets the standard.

From advanced editing to creative AI.
components.css: .ds-intro{max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;text-align:center;font:400 18px/27px 'Adobe Clean',adobe-clean,'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif;color:#000}.ds-intro h2{margin:8px 0 16px;font:900 56px/56px 'Adobe Clean Display','Adobe Clean',adobe-clean,'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif;letter-spacing:-1.68px}.ds-eyebrow{margin:0;font:700 16px/20px 'Adobe Clean',adobe-clean,'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif}

narrative.overview: Heavy black display type, one Adobe blue for action, light and black bands, rounded media cards and scroll-driven reveals; imagery and video carry the colour.
keyCharacteristics: Adobe Clean Display 900 with tight tracking
